notes.title: Patch Notes build 166
notes.content:
Greetings, Wardens!

Thank you so much for your support and feedback over the last week. The launch of The Serpent Rogue is something we've been working towards for a long time, and we're so happy to see players enjoying their time with the game.

Your input has been invaluable, and has allowed us to quickly work on a patch that fixes several issues that have been raised, while also adding some quality of life changes to help improve your experience as Wardens!

Please keep your feedback coming! If you're enjoying the game, we'd highly recommend joining us over on Discord.

Patch Notes:

- New: effects on destroying stoned creatures

- New: ghouls can now be of different genders

- New: wood logs can now be found in some containers on the Wasteland as well

- Change: Weapons durability highly increased

- Change: Crafting can now have three slots for ingredients when brewing potions

- Change: description of some items in localization

- Change: the way Undertaker resurrects creatures (now the process is much faster)

- Change: adjusted Astroscopus attack distances

- Change: Snake attack range reduced

- Change: Removed icons from unusable icons on the map

- Change: Added one more moonstone on Swamp

- Change: Valravn can now sprint even on low Vitality

- Change: Worms in stump are now respawning on Pier location

- Change: Undertaker now can take damaged and brand new shovels as a payment

- Fix: infinite load issue

- Fix: crash when traveling between locations while riding on a Valravn

- Fix: not passable area after burning some objects

- Fix: Swamp softlock fix

- Fix: consuming food while being in the animal form changed players' race back to default

- Fix: Valravn maximum age could sometimes not trigger correctly

- Fix: changing weapons bug

- Fix: SFX of some attacks wasn’t stopping at some times

- Fix: fleeing Ghouls could behave in a wrong way in certain circumstances

- Fix: attacking while riding on Valravn

- Fix: gathering Reed and Poppy ingredient

- Fix: valravn special ability could sometimes throw the player behind the playable area

- Fix: popups could sometimes be opened in the wrong triggers

- Fix: age UI was not always updating correctly

- Fix: some achievements could be not activated properly

- Fix: interaction with Extractor was sometimes not responsive

notes.title: The Serpent Rogue - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Wardens! The time has come![/h1]

The Serpent Rogue is [b]out now[/b] on Steam!

As the mysteriously plague-masked protagonist The Warden, players must explore the world, utilise and craft crucial potions to cleanse the world of the malevolent corruption known as the Serpent Rogue and restore balance to the lands surrounding Mount Morbus.

The perfect blend of gameplay awaits: [previewyoutube=QQxg_wb3qEE;full][/previewyoutube]

Alchemy is one of the key ingredients in The Serpent Rogue’s gameplay and mastering it will be pivotal to The Warden’s success; collect and research ingredients to unveil their uses, experiment with different mixtures to craft unique potions, and use those concoctions in a variety of ways to progress through the everchanging world. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40971068/c4e3aeb82f99e7822865beb7a0a467f3e3a9b4f7.gif[/img]

The Serpent Rogue allows players to tackle challenges in a myriad of ways; adversaries can be defeated through head-to-head open combat, perfectly timed alchemic potions, or by befriending and taming local beasts. Each step on The Warden’s journey is fraught with challenges and decisions, the echoes of which can be felt across the wider world. For instance, leaving food lying around will cause havoc by attracting vermin to the area, while bodies left unburied will lure fearsome ghouls, so The Warden will have to make sure to tread carefully. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40971068/a53f887cabe87cb668f822b4d9d17a5f258e3f68.png[/img]

[b]The Serpent Rogue key features[/b]

•	Sandbox roguelike: Explore the mysterious world of The Serpent Rogue; locations and items are 
        randomised by storms that sweep the land

•	Permutations aplenty: Utilise the magic and crafting of alchemy to create new tactics to overcome 
        the many threats and situations created by the corruption of the Serpent Rogue

•	Cause and effect: The Warden’s actions have consequences that can be used to their advantage; 
        but will they become the hero of the tale… or the villain?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40971068/cb0b1acb0f12411190b9b058bf789e365d160cce.jpg[/img]

The Serpent Rogue is available to purchase now on Steam; a demo for the game is also available to play. To keep up to date with all the information on The Serpent Rogue please like the game on [url=https://www.facebook.com/theserpentrogue/]Facebook[/url], follow it on [url=https://twitter.com/TheSerpentRogue]Twitter[/url] and join us on [url=https://discord.gg/HJnXrhGdnE]Discord[/url].

[h3]Play The Serpent Rogue NOW[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1453790/The_Serpent_Rogue/

notes.title: The Serpent Rogue - Exploration
notes.content:
[b]Exploration[/b]

Wardens!

In The Serpent Rogue It is your task to confront the impending evil, and bring peace to the realm. Keep your wits about you as you traverse the ever changing world, in search of rare ingredients and secrets long forgotten.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40971068/a53f887cabe87cb668f822b4d9d17a5f258e3f68.png[/img]

Explore every inch of the map, unearth hidden passages, and expand your knowledge to survive this hostile world.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40971068/3b57d119d6be2b4fb39691d720eb4d75ec848c5a.gif[/img]

With so many places to explore, you must be prepared with potions a plenty. Craft a variety of elixirs to ensure your survival, or risk succumbing to the evil that stalks the realm.

notes.title: The Serpent Rogue - Choose Your Actions
notes.content:
[b]Hey Wardens![/b]

As we move closer to launch, we wanted to delve deeper into the features of the game.

Your actions have consequences and directly impact how the world will respond to your presence. Be careful while exploring and make sure you don't leave any loose ends, or they may come back to haunt you.

[b]Choose your actions carefully[/b]
Each action you take will create interesting sequences of cause and effect. If you forget to bury the perished ones, you’ll start to attract corpse-eating ghouls. Keep too many creatures in one place and this will attract blood-thirsty reapers. Hoard too many items in one location and attract plague-spreading vermin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40971068/c4e3aeb82f99e7822865beb7a0a467f3e3a9b4f7.gif[/img]

Make sure you keep things under control, Wardens. Or you may be faced with some difficult challenges ahead.

Embark on your quest when The Serpent Rogue lands on PC on April 26th. Wishlist now: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1453790/The_Serpent_Rogue/

notes.title: The Serpent Rogue - Crafting Potions
notes.content:
Hey Wardens! 

As we approach the launch of The Serpent Rogue, we wanted to go into a bit more detail about some of the things you can do in game!

Using your alchemy skills is crucial; craft and experiment with different ingredients to create extraordinary potions each with their own unique effects, including the ability to shapeshift into different creatures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40971068/5573071e2acb76c8266f34c38c2fd57895d5333b.gif[/img]

As well as shapeshifting, you can make devastating potions that put enemies at major disadvantage in battle such as increasing their hunger, making them restless and causing damage through status effects such as burns and poison!

You can also craft potions that put you at an advantage by summoning creatures to aid you, health potions as well as removing any status effects hindering you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40971068/3b57d119d6be2b4fb39691d720eb4d75ec848c5a.gif[/img]

Be careful to not use a wrong combination of ingredients - the outcome is not pretty 🤮

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40971068/b9103d70f9b58c97cbc24e76ff4c2483ae9bce98.gif[/img]

Do you think your alchemy skills will be enough to quell the darkness?

The Serpent Rogue comes to Steam on April 26th!

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1453790/The_Serpent_Rogue/

notes.title: Team17 Presents… The Serpent Rogue
notes.content:
Explore a medieval fantasy world where all your actions have consequences…

Gather resources and master alchemy arts to create potions that transform, heal or poison.

Developed by Sengi Games, this is…The Serpent Rogue!

[previewyoutube=2uMMEGfhfpA;full][/previewyoutube]

You’ll take on the role of The Warden – a mysterious character out to confront and destroy a corrupting force known as Morbus (The Serpent Rogue) that threatens to take over the medieval realm. 

As The Warden, you must restore balance to the natural world, but be warned, all your actions have consequences! Craft and experiment with potions and recipes that will change, or even create, situations to your advantage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32941731/3b57d119d6be2b4fb39691d720eb4d75ec848c5a.gif[/img]

The Warden’s actions will also affect the ecosystem, from dreaded Reapers devouring too many pets left in a single location, to ghouls attracted to the unburied going on to attack everything standing in their way. 

The wonders of alchemy even extend to therianthropy and shapeshifting, allowing The Warden to transform into any creature, and allow any creature to be transformed into another – including The Warden!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32941731/4d2b46545c4e5324a053828250701eda43841a32.gif[/img]

These things combined create a wealth of potential strategies and tactics to overcome the darkness of Morbus…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32941731/c4e3aeb82f99e7822865beb7a0a467f3e3a9b4f7.gif[/img]

[u][i]The Serpent Rogue[/i] key features[/u]
[list]
[*][b]Sandbox roguelike:[/b] Explore the mysterious world of The Serpent Rogue; locations and items are fully randomised as The Serpent Rogue unleashes storms and other natural disasters
[*][b]Permutations aplenty:[/b] Utilise the magic and crafting of alchemy to create new tactics to overcome the many threats and situations created by Morbus
[*][b]Cause and effect:[/b] The Warden’s actions have consequences that can be used to their advantage; but will they become the hero of the tale… or the villain?

[h2]Ready to take on Morbus? Try out [i]The Serpent Rogue[/i] with a free demo available now and don't forget to add it to your Steam Wishlist![/h2]
